harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker to run as the systemd-managed service inventory-worker under a dedicated system account inventorysvc on node1, then verified restart persistence by rebooting node1 and confirming the service auto-started with a changed boot identity.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: confirmed the worker binary exists, OS is CentOS Stream 10 with SELinux enforcing, and no inventorysvc user or inventory-worker service pre-existed

Wrote /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service running ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as User=inventorysvc/Group=inventorysvc with hardening (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome, Restart=on-failure)
Ran systemctl daemon-reload and systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service; verified active status, correct running user (inventorysvc), and process tree
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a, service active+enabled
Issued sudo -n systemctl reboot on node1 (backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnection)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed changed boot_id (93e2b701-bd56-4d6a-b0a2-0b1a720ffc61), proving an actual restart occurred
Verified post-restart recovery: inventory-worker.service active and enabled, main process running as inventorysvc

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker runs as systemd service inventory-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: Baseline showed no existing user/service; after creating inventorysvc and the unit file, systemctl enable --now started inventory-worker.service with MainPID owned by user inventorysvc running the exact worker binary

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a) and confirmed inventory-worker.service was active and enabled

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background; exec stream closed as the node went down, consistent with acknowledgement returning before disconnection

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable during reboot (connection timed out on two polls), then came back with boot_id 93e2b701-bd56-4d6a-b0a2-0b1a720ffc61, differing from the pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: post-restart service recovery
evidence.summary: After restart, inventory-worker.service is active and enabled, with MainPID's process owned by inventorysvc running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, confirming the service survived the reboot via systemd enablement

attempts.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker to run as the systemd-managed service inventory-worker under a dedicated system account inventorysvc on node1, then verified restart persistence by rebooting node1 and confirming the service auto-started with a changed boot identity.
